name: E-methane (synthetic natural gas)
principle: Hydrogen and CO2 react in a methanation reactor (Sabatier) to make methane that can enter the gas grid. Tokyo Gas began a trial in 2022 at its Yokohama research centre with a Hitachi Zosen methanation unit, first at 12.5 Nm3/h, then 400 Nm3/h in the late 2020s and 20,000 Nm3/h overseas in 2030. A 6.3 MW synthetic methane plant in Germany received RFNBO certificates.
